column1: # Held-out Revit models with Revit's own IFC export with base quantities on, for checking a rule
# derived on the other reference models against files it was not derived on (RE-252, #1046):
# the flowbim.ee single-dwelling house (Revit 2026, Revit 26.4's IFC4X3 export, RE-124) and two of
# 255ribeiro/intro_ifc's projects (modelo_bim, saved in Revit 2023 and exported by Revit 26.2;
# teste_export_2025, Revit 2025 and its 25.4 export), at commit 5a0e9fa2. No redistribution licence
# is stated for any of them, so they are fetched from their public sources for a Measure run
# (`-f holdout=true`) by tools/ci/fetch-holdout-models.sh, never committed, and only their summary
# teste_export_2025's export does not match its saved file on one wall: every record of the .rvt
# gives it a 200 mm type, the export (made hours after the last save) a 300 mm one the file also
# holds (RE-253). The maintainer chose (2026-10-27) to treat that as an inconsistency of the pair
# (#1048): tools/re/qtos_vs_ifc.py counts that wall's Width apart.
